        ll flow, capacity;
    };

    int s, t;

    int dist[MAX_N], visited[MAX_N], cur[MAX_N];

    void clear() {
        edges.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; ++i) adj[i].clear();
    }

    void add_edge(int u, int v, ll cap) {
        edges.push_back({u, v, 0, cap});
        edges.push_back({v, u, 0, 0});
        adj[u].push_back((int)edges.size() - 2);
        adj[v].push_back((int)edges.size() - 1);
    }

    bool bfs() {
        memset(visited, 0, sizeof(visited));
        memset(dist, 0, sizeof(dist));
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(s);
        visited[s] = true;
        dist[s] = 0;

        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            for (int idx : adj[u]) {
                auto &e = edges[idx];
                int v = e.to;
                if (!visited[v] && e.capacity > e.flow) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                    visited[v] = true;
                    q.push(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return visited[t];

        if (u == t || !flow) return flow;
        ll pushed = 0;

                if (f > 0) {

                    edges[idx ^ 1].flow -= f;
                    pushed += f;
                    flow -= f;
                    if (!flow) break;
                }
            }
        }
        return pushed;
    }

    ll max_flow() {
        ll result = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            memset(cur, 0, sizeof(cur));
            result += dfs(s, INF);
        }
        return result;
    }

struct FlowGraph {

    vector<Edge> edge_list;
    vector<int> adj[MAX_VERTEX];

        edge_list.push_back({v, u, 0, 0});
        adj[u].push_back(edge_list.size() - 2);
        adj[v].push_back(edge_list.size() - 1);

        return depth[sink_id] != -1;
    }

    i64 dfs_flow(int u, i64 flow) {
        if (u == sink_id || !flow) return flow;

    }
